familyOrModelDisplayName.description: The display name of the device family or model associated with the returned tag.

tag.description: The unique identifier for the device setting.

value.description: The current value of the setting at device level. If the tag value is not set at the device level, this field will not be included in the response.

parentValue.description: The setting value at the next available `parentLevel`. It is used if `value` is not set and is omitted when no parent level exists for the tag.
